newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Harbor spot jet prices off on rising supply.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Harbor spot jet prices off on rising supply.

text.p: New York cash jet fuel prices remained slack Tuesday after starting the week lower as high refinery runs have created ample supply, traders said.
NYH prompt 54-grade was offered at 0.50 cent over the June NYMEX futures just as it was Monday, 1.00 cent down from a week ago.
"There is decent jet fuel supply right now. The higher run rates are key in that. As long as refiners keep pumping out gasoline like this, it will continue," said a New York Harbor trader.
NYH prompt 55-grade low sulfur jet fuel traded at 1.25 over the June NYMEX.
